api-design.md.provides: Internal payments API goals, HMAC auth, charge + webhook flow, open v1 questions.
api-design.md.coverageNote: Covers auth, happy-path charge, and webhook semantics. Thin on error codes, partial captures decision, and exact backoff schedule.

keypoints.title: HMAC request auth
keypoints.body: Server-to-server calls sign timestamp.method.path.body with HMAC-SHA256; 90-day key rotation; 5-minute skew.

keypoints.title: Idempotent charges + outbox webhooks
keypoints.body: POST /v1/charges requires Idempotency-Key; success enqueues charge.succeeded; workers deliver at-least-once; receivers must be idempotent.

keypoints.title: Open: partial captures & retry budget
keypoints.body: v1 still undecided on partial captures; webhook retry draft is 8 attempts with exponential backoff.

nda-excerpt.md.provides: Mutual NDA purpose, Confidential Information definition, exclusions, term/survival, residuals status.
nda-excerpt.md.coverageNote: Strong on definition, exclusions, and survival. Thin on affiliates, residuals policy choice, and governing law (not in excerpt).

keypoints.title: Reasonable-person confidential standard
keypoints.body: Covers marked confidential info and info that would reasonably be understood as confidential.

keypoints.title: Survival vs trade secrets
keypoints.body: Agreement term 2 years; confidentiality survives 3 years after termination; trade secrets survive while they remain trade secrets.

keypoints.title: No residuals clause
keypoints.body: This draft has no residuals clause — unaided memory use is not carved out.

term-sheet.md.provides: Seed SAFE economics, board/protective provisions, close timing and exclusivity.
term-sheet.md.coverageNote: Covers amount/cap, pref, pro-rata, board, protectives, exclusivity. Thin on counsel, conditions precedent, and employee option pool (not stated).

keypoints.title: $2.5M on $10M post-money SAFE
keypoints.body: Lead Northbridge; valuation cap is post-money SAFE structure.

keypoints.title: 1x non-participating preference
keypoints.body: Liquidation preference is 1x non-participating; major investors get pro-rata; MFN on SAFEs for 120 days.

keypoints.title: Board + 30-day exclusivity
keypoints.body: Board is 2 founders + 1 lead. Sheet mostly non-binding except confidentiality/exclusivity; exclusivity 30 days; target close 45 days.
